Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 10
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly interpreted the release date information for "Farber's Nerve". While the WebSurfer correctly identified that the earliest *verified* release date on the IMDb page was April 2011 (DVD), the Planner failed to recognize that this was a post-production home media release and not the film's initial release. The search results explicitly mentioned the film was a "Short 2006" and the Wikipedia snippet indicated a 2006 release. By ignoring the "2006" year label and the context of a short film (which often have festival premieres years before DVD releases) and relying solely on the specific "Release info" section showing DVD dates, the Planner drew a false conclusion that Farber's Nerve was released in 2011. This led to the erroneous conclusion that Ekam (2010) was released first, when in reality, Farber's Nerve (2006) was released first. The error was a failure to synthesize the "Short 2006" metadata with the DVD release date to determine the true chronological order.
